_doc: Thresholds for rq_flags.py. Each check has a metric, an op (a flag fires when `value op limit` holds), and a warn and/or fail limit. A fail turns the job into a failed result when fail_marks_job_failed is true. rq_flags.py calibrate proposes edits to the warn and fail limits from rejections.jsonl. Units: luminance 0-255; fractions 0-1; *_per_mpx per million pixels of figure. A check may carry by_quality: {"denoised": {...}} limits for jobs rendered with --denoise or at quality check.

black_frame.msg: the image is black or nearly black

white_frame.msg: the image is white or blown out

blank_frame.msg: the image is one flat colour

figure_missing.msg: a panel is almost all background: the figure is missing, hidden or off camera

figure_cropped.msg: the figure runs off a panel edge

noise.msg: speckled surfaces: sampling noise on the figure

black_patches.msg: pure black areas on the figure (out of transparent or light bounces, or a broken shader)

missing_texture.msg: magenta pixels: a missing texture or a broken material

unexpected_alpha.msg: transparent pixels in a view that should be opaque

same_as_main.msg: the image is the same as main's render of this view: the change does not show

same_as_previous.msg: the image is the same as the last render of this view at an earlier commit

frozen_animation.msg: animation frames are identical or nearly so: the pose does not move

wrong_size.msg: the image is not the size or aspect the request asked for

tiny_file.msg: the file is smaller than any real render of its kind

missing_output.msg: an expected output file was not written

log_error.msg: the log has an error or traceback although the job exited 0

glb_empty.msg: the .glb has no scene, nodes or mesh data

glb_no_skin.msg: the .glb has no skin, or fewer joints than before

glb_bad_vertices.msg: NaN, infinite or extreme vertex positions

glb_bad_weights.msg: skin weights that do not sum to 1, or joints out of range

glb_bounds.msg: the model's size changed a lot from the last export
